findings.statement: In 2026Q2, total nurse staffing was 4.35 hours per resident day (RN 0.89, LPN 0.82, aides 2.64); the Connecticut median that quarter was 3.82.

evidence.dataset: Payroll-Based Journal Daily Nurse Staffing

findings.formula: PBJ paid nursing hours / resident days

findings.statement: Contract (agency) staff made up 0.6% of nursing hours in 2026Q2 (Connecticut median 3.8%).

evidence.dataset: Payroll-Based Journal Daily Nurse Staffing

findings.formula: PBJ contract hours / all nursing hours x 100

findings.statement: Total nurse staffing changed by +0.61 hours per resident day from 2018Q1 (3.74) to 2026Q2 (4.35).

evidence.dataset: Payroll-Based Journal Daily Nurse Staffing

findings.formula: latest quarter HPRD - first quarter HPRD
